stages.title: SEVENFOLD PREDICATION (SAPTABHAṄGĪ) SEVENFOLD BRANCH

pills.text: ABOUT OBJECT X, UNDER SPECIFIED STANDPOINT
IN SOME RESPECT, X IS NOT
SUCCESSIVELY, X IS AND IS NOT

sequence: ABOUT OBJECT X, UNDER SPECIFIED STANDPOINT / TIME / MODE
1 syād-asti → in some respect, X is
2 syān-nāsti → in some respect, X is not
3 syād-asti-nāsti → successively, X is and is not
4 syād-avaktavyaḥ → X is inexpressible under simultaneous demand

groups.heading: ADVANCED OBJECTION
items: Tattvārthasūtra supplies a common doctrinal grammar without erasing Śvetāmbara-Digambara differences.
This matters methodologically: cite the text as a shared systematic anchor, but do not infer complete uniformity of canon or practice.
Tīrthaṅkaras are perfected teachers rather than creators, so Jaina religious authority remains compatible with an uncreated cosmos.
The deeper philosophical architecture is reciprocal.

groups.heading: COMPARATIVE NUANCE
items: Metaphysical many-sidedness explains epistemic partiality
epistemic discipline supports ethical non-violence in thought
ethical purification removes the karmic obstruction that prevents complete knowledge.
Treating these as unrelated chapters misses the system's unity.
